title: Diplomat Murder Case
subtitle_source: case_closed_dataset/subs_resolved/0048.txt (407 dialogue lines) + case_closed_dataset/subs_resolved/0049.txt (370 dialogue lines), full two-part transcript read
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan/Shinichi, Heiji Hattori, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. The apparent locked-room mechanism (fishing line threading the key into the victim's pocket) is itself a red herring the culprit planted throughout the house to frame the victim's father, who then falsely confesses for reasons the transcript never states -- the real trick is a 'psychological locked room': the victim was only drugged, not dead, when investigators assumed he'd already been murdered half an hour earlier, and the culprit killed him herself while alone with him during the 'discovery'. The character-card label calls p6 the victim's 'Grandfather', but his own line ('I was the one who killed my son Isao') identifies him as Isao's father; the father relationship is used here as the more authoritative source. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: For the key to end up fully inside the victim's tight double pocket (as found), it would have had to flip over after entering key-first -- but the snug pocket folds and blocks exactly that motion (demonstrated live on Inspector Megure's own pants), meaning the key must have been placed inside by hand beforehand, not pulled in on a thread from outside a locked room.

Kimie's key holder is identical in outward design to the victim's, but conceals a hidden groove sized exactly for the poison needle -- proof she carried the murder weapon in plain sight the whole time.

A 20-year-old photograph of a young Kimie is nearly identical to Yukiko Katsuragi except for hair color, revealing Kimie is secretly Yukiko's biological mother from her first marriage to Kenji Yamashiro -- the diplomat Isao framed and destroyed two decades earlier.
